sources.title: Smartphone Image Denoising Dataset (SIDD)
sources.notes: Official SIDD page states dataset and associated code repositories are under MIT License. Use full paired sRGB data for the real-noise lane; SIDD-Small is smoke/debug only.

sources.title: GOPRO_Large dynamic scene deblurring dataset
sources.notes: Official dataset page states GOPRO dataset is released under CC BY 4.0. Preserve attribution metadata.

sources.title: Library of Congress Free to Use and Reuse sets
sources.notes: Use only records whose item rights are explicitly Public Domain, CC0 or another contract-allowed license. Do not assume every loc.gov item is reusable. Keep archive exam source groups separate from synthetic training sources.

sources.title: DIV2K
sources.notes: Useful benchmark/research source. Keep disabled for release training unless licensing is explicitly cleared for the intended use.

sources.title: REDS / NTIRE restoration data
sources.notes: Current ALMAZ JPEG model is derived from a REDS-trained NAFNet checkpoint. Before fine-tuning release models on REDS data, Codex must verify dataset redistribution/training terms and record them in SOURCES.lock.json.

sources.title: FFHQ
sources.notes: Do not use for release training by default. If used at all, keep to research-only experiments/benchmark under its actual terms. Prefer permissively licensed/public-domain face photos for release evaluation.
